name: tier1
what: round 6's compute plan 'tier1': the runs of tier1 packed into 16 jobs by LPT on their estimated CPU seconds (twin/bench6.py plan); each job is one runner working through its run ids with `ids --hours 5.2`, a wave at a time, a run still going at 5.2 h carried on by the same job of the next wave from its checkpoint. Everything is simulated.
